question: Identify the top 15 drivers with the fastest personal best lap times in Formula 1 history. For each driver, return their full name, nationality, and age as of today. Only consider drivers who have recorded a lap time faster than 1 minute 20 seconds.

WITH driver_best_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt."XCL_044" AS driver_id,
        MIN(lt."XCL_048") AS best_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt."XCL_048" IS NOT NULL
      AND lt."XCL_048" < 80000
    GROUP BY lt."XCL_044"
)
SELECT
    d."XCL_038" AS first_name,
    d."XCL_039" AS last_name,
    d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
    (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', d."XCL_040")) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', d."XCL_040")) AS age
FROM driver_best_laps AS dbl
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON dbl.driver_id = d."XCL_034"
ORDER BY dbl.best_lap_ms ASC
LIMIT 15
